pipeline: EvidenceIndex.stage/upsert/activate -> HybridAgentSearch -> EvidenceAgent.submit -> AgentRunner.advance_one + Hybrid evaluation arms

provenance.agent_search: HybridAgentSearch(deterministic embedding/vector, pinned-scope RRF, rerank disabled)
provenance.claim_boundary: This validates deterministic architecture, safety and regression behavior; it is not a real-model quality benchmark.

rerank.note: No production reranker is configured; this is a labeled recording arm.

v4_9_single_shot_proxy.label: proxy_not_historical_runtime
v4_9_single_shot_proxy.method: one active-scope sparse query capped at legacy top-4
v4_9_single_shot_proxy.limitations: This is a V4.9-style single-shot proxy on the V5 canonical corpus, not a claim that the historical release was rerun unchanged.

retrieval_only.method: dense+sparse reciprocal-rank fusion top-10, no Agent loop

evidence_agent.method: typed deterministic recording model over production Agent state machine + HybridAgentSearch with deterministic dense vectors, pinned-scope sparse search, reciprocal-rank fusion, and no configured reranker
